name: Primary Vitreoretinal Large B-Cell Lymphoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for Primary Vitreoretinal Large B-Cell Lymphoma

criteria.description: Detection of malignant large B-cells in vitreous fluid cytology
Immunophenotyping showing CD20+ large B-cells in ocular samples
Detection of monoclonal immunoglobulin gene rearrangement in vitreous or retinal tissue
Characteristic ocular imaging findings including subretinal infiltrates on OCT and vitreous opacities on ultrasound

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of malignant large B-cells in vitreous cytology and positive immunohistochemistry for CD20
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis often requires combined cytology, immunohistochemistry, and molecular studies due to paucity of malignant cells.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Vitreous cellular infiltration with clumps of malignant lymphoid cells
searchTerms: eye vitreous infiltration by lymphoma cells
slow worsening of eyesight without pain

occasional.symptomName: Optic nerve involvement causing visual field defects
searchTerms: optic nerve damage causing vision gaps
blind spots from optic nerve problems
visual field loss due to optic nerve

rare.symptomName: Central nervous system involvement presenting with neurological deficits
searchTerms: nerve deficits due to central nervous system disease
eye involvement in both eyes initially

rare.symptomName: Systemic lymphoma symptoms such as night sweats or weight loss
searchTerms: fever and weight loss from lymphoma

laboratory: Vitreous fluid cytology showing large atypical lymphoid cells
Monoclonal immunoglobulin heavy chain gene rearrangement by PCR
imaging: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) showing subretinal infiltrates
B-scan ocular ultrasound revealing vitreous opacities
genetic: MYD88 L265P mutation reported in some cases
other: Elevated interleukin-10 (IL-10) levels in vitreous fluid
Brain MRI may show concurrent CNS lymphoma lesions

distinguishingFeatures: Absence of malignant lymphoid cells in vitreous fluid

redFlags: Presence of vitreous cellular clumps resistant to steroids
Concurrent or subsequent central nervous system lymphoma
references: Chan CC, et al. Primary vitreoretinal lymphoma: diagnosis and management. Int Ophthalmol Clin. 2019.
Ding Y, et al. Molecular features of primary vitreoretinal lymphoma. Front Oncol. 2021.
Orphanet: Primary vitreoretinal large B-cell lymphoma (ORPHA:695631).
